column1: # Stat Book pages (docs/statbook.md; tools/statbook.py turns this into the plugin's book file). kind page: id + tab title;
# section: a heading line; row: label, stats (itemstatcost names; a,b for two values; name:class = the player's class as param),
# format (%d %+d %% only, or yesno / block), colour (w r b y p m gold blue green), cap (N or N+stat<=M: gold at or over it),
# base (added per value, e.g. 0,75 for a max resistance). Rows whose stats a game's itemstatcost lacks are left out of that book.
